scope: Frozen final-project cost evaluation: when tuning pays, and whether prior choices or a shortlist suffice. No new selector or positive-result requirement.
primary: Measured total operational seconds through1536 requests; report every method/batch/order and shorter endpoints. No tuning based on holdout.
profile_protocol: Nested interleaved balanced profile order, identical for pair/full. First64:22alpaca/21gsm8k/21mbpp; full192:64each. One warmup+one timed pass per candidate; all wall time charged.
controls: Fixed3/fixed7 do no new profiling. Prior load rule uses7 at batch8 and3 at batch64; report separately from universal fixed widths. Pair uses3,7; full uses1..7.
cost_accounting: Actual monotonic pipeline clock through useful inference, including imports, engine startup, profiling warmup/timed passes, file/check overhead, selection, profiling teardown and deployment startup. Queue, final deployment shutdown and common AR-reference/correctness preparation excluded and reported separately where available. Cached-start native-per-width engine setup; not an intrinsic lower bound on profiling cost.
analysis: Profiling cost breakdown from stage wall, measured engine initialization and generation durations. Break-even estimates use actual wall-time slope between384 and1536 requests, including recurring checks/file overhead, compare every method to both fixed controls and pair of equal budget. Report two orders separately; if slopes do not favor tuned choice or selected widths identical, no defensible finite inference-based break-even. Extrapolated crossings explicitly labelled unmeasured. No CI from two orders or repeated prompts.
limits: Same96 heldout prompts as v112; supplemental cost analysis on a declared reused evaluation set, not new independent confirmation.
Prior8B profiling inspected; no blind transfer claim.
64versus192 preserves batch sizes but affects domain composition slightly and mixes domains; v112 used clustered domains, so budget effect is evaluated withinv115 only.
Two measured budgets cannot establish a universal minimum sample size.
Outputs truncated at64tokens; single8B model/H200. Earlier4B evidence uses a different numerical configuration.
Native candidate width requires fresh engines in this implementation; startup-dominated findings are implementation-specific.
stop_rule: Any exact output mismatch aborts. Every heldout native batch checked against fresh AR; no output filtering or retries to remove failures.
